result:
I've fixed all nine reported problems. The type check is clean and all 616 existing tests pass, but I didn't add any tests for the new behaviour.

**Mentions (reports 1, 2, 6)**
- Mentions now work for every active member: the lookup pages through the whole workspace instead of stopping at 100 members (`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`).
- Read-only members are no longer skipped, and a handle shared by several members mentions all of them (`src/lib/mentions.ts`).
- The recorded mentions are now exactly what the text mentions, minus the author. Mention IDs sent by the client are no longer merged in.

**Alerts (reports 3, 8)**
- Each person gets at most one alert per comment, and a mention alert replaces the "comment added" alert (`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`).
- The author of the comment being answered is now alerted too. The comment's own author gets nothing.

**Edits (reports 6, 7)**
- The fifteen-minute limit now counts from when the comment was first posted, not from the last edit.
- An edit re-reads the mentions from the new text, saves them, and alerts only people who weren't mentioned before. This works through a new `comment.updated` event.
- The search index is refreshed on edit, so the new wording is searchable.

**Thread (reports 4, 5)**
- Each top-level comment now lists every reply beneath it, however deep, in order of posting (`src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`).
- Deleted comments stay as placeholders with their text removed, so their replies stay in place.

**Posting limit (report 9)**
- The comment rate limit is now charged per member rather than per workspace. I added an optional per-member key to `consumeRateLimit` in `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`; other limits are unchanged.
